topics.title: 课程作业与学习辅助
topics.summary: 原则上允许在教学和学习辅助中使用AI以达成课程学习目标，具体使用规则由各课程负责人开课时明确说明。
topics.scope: 学生教学与学习辅助官方指引
topics.evidenceScope: Studies Service official teaching & learning guidelines

claims.text: General rule permits AI use in teaching and learning if pedagogically justified; course coordinators decide on rules for their courses.

evidence.quote: As a rule, AI use is permitted in teaching and in support of learning. AI use must support the achievement of course learning outcomes and be pedagogically justified.
evidence.title: Using AI to support learning (University of Helsinki Studies Service)
evidence.location: Using AI to support learning > Artificial intelligence guidelines in a nutshell

topics.title: 考试与成熟度测试
topics.summary: 成熟度测试中禁止使用AI。
topics.scope: 成熟度测试禁令及课程考场规则
topics.evidenceScope: Maturity test rules and course exam conditions

claims.text: AI use is forbidden in maturity tests.

evidence.quote: In maturity tests, the use of AI is forbidden.
evidence.title: Using AI to support learning (University of Helsinki Studies Service)
evidence.location: Using AI to support learning > Artificial intelligence guidelines in a nutshell

topics.title: 书面作业强制披露
topics.summary: 在书面作品中，学生必须按照单独指引声明是否使用AI，即使个别课程没有专门要求。
topics.scope: 书面作业强制披露要求

claims.text: In written work, students must disclose their use or non-use of AI according to separate instructions, even if individual courses do not specifically request it.

evidence.quote: In written work, you must disclose your use or non-use of AI in accordance with separate instructions, even when not specifically instructed to do so in individual courses.
evidence.title: Using AI to support learning (University of Helsinki Studies Service)
evidence.location: Using AI to support learning > Guidelines for disclosing generative AI use

topics.title: 数据保护与隐私限制
topics.summary: 大学指引明确规定，严禁在Copilot中处理个人数据。
topics.evidenceScope: IT Helpdesk data classification and Copilot limits

claims.text: Personal data must not be processed in Copilot.

evidence.quote: Personal data must not be processed in Copilot.
evidence.title: Generative AI at the University (Helpdesk Instructions)
evidence.location: Generative AI at the University > Data protection

topics.title: 校级支持AI服务
topics.summary: 赫尔辛基大学为年满18周岁的教职工与学生提供微软Copilot Chat，须通过学校账号认证登录。
topics.scope: 校级支持平台及图书馆服务目录
topics.evidenceScope: Campus supported platforms and library directory

claims.text: Microsoft Copilot Chat is provided to university staff and students over the age of 18 using institutional credentials.

evidence.quote: The University of Helsinki has two general-purpose generative AI solutions: Microsoft Copilot Chat, available for all students and staff members over the age of 18, and CurreChat, which is restricted for use for teaching purposes.
evidence.title: Generative AI at the University (Helpdesk Instructions)
evidence.location: Generative AI at the University > Services

topics.title: 科研与论文署名
topics.statusLabel: 原则上不可列为共同作者
topics.summary: 大学指引指出，原则上不能将生成式AI列为共同作者。
topics.scope: 科研诚信与生成式AI指引

claims.text: University guidance says that, in general, generative AI cannot be listed as a co-author.

evidence.quote: In general, GenAI cannot be listed as a co-author.

additionalTopics.scope: 学生纪律处分与抄袭界定规定

additionalTopics.scope: 教务委员会教师教学与评分指引
